concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-platforms-online-payments-split-transactions-split-refunds]] — 2026-09-15 Platforms Checkout refund split-booking guide covering explicit debits, authorization-ratio fallback, liable-account fallback and asynchronous refund/transfer evidence.
warnings: A refund request and test webhook examples do not prove shopper receipt or completed live money movement; this is not a merchant-of-record or chargeback guide.
The split-item table labels account required, while the Commission request example omits it; preserve this unresolved example/schema tension rather than generalizing the omission.
A successful-format request can still book the transaction and fees to the liable balance if an account is absent or its holder is closed.
